beats.event: Gandalf arranges the dwarves' invasion of Bilbo's home
Thorin recruits Bilbo as burglar for the Lonely Mountain
Trolls capture the party; Gandalf tricks them into daylight
Rest at Rivendell; Elrond deciphers moon-runes on the map
Goblins capture them beneath the Misty Mountains
Bilbo finds a mysterious ring in the dark tunnels
Wins a riddle contest with Gollum; escapes with the ring
In Mirkwood Bilbo rescues dwarves from giant spiders
Frees the dwarves from Wood-elf dungeons
Lake-town welcomes them as prophesied dragon-slayers
Bilbo scouts Smaug's lair; steals cup, finds bare patch
Enraged Smaug flies out and attacks Lake-town
Bard the Bowman kills Smaug through the bare patch
Bilbo secretly gives Arkenstone to besiegers to force peace
Goblin and Warg armies arrive; Battle of Five Armies begins
Eagles and Beorn turn the tide; Thorin dies reconciled
Bilbo returns to the Shire, wealthy but humble
